title: Onboarding spotlight & quickstart: contrast overhaul and symbol language refresh for dark mode
creator: Asha Gupta
description: Objective: Perform a comprehensive accessibility and dark-mode pass for the onboarding spotlight/quickstart assets used in the product tour, first-run modal, and docs screenshots. This includes revising iconography for low-light legibility, auditing color contrast against WCAG 2.1 AA (and AAA where feasible), producing dev-ready token exports and responsive screenshot templates, and creating a short QA checklist for engineers and content writers. Focus areas: contrast tokens, symbol stroke weights, semantic icon set (avoid purely decorative glyphs for informative icons), overlay/backdrop opacity in dark mode, and motion-safe micro-interactions in the tutorial flows.
acceptance_criteria: All onboarding screens (web + mobile guided tour and first-run modal) meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios for text and interactive elements (4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text where applicable)
Primary onboarding icons have distinct shapes and maintain legibility at 16px and up in both light and dark themes
Figma file contains a tokenized color and elevation sheet with explicit hex values for light/dark tokens and a mapping JSON exported for dev (tokens.json)
Three screenshot templates (desktop 1440x900, tablet 1024x768, mobile 390x844) with annotated safe areas and overlay hints are added to the docs assets folder
Design handoff PR with export slices and changed components created and linked to a GitHub PR; engineering sign-off obtained via review comment
QA checklist completed and passed by the Accessibility SME and one frontend engineer in staging
comments: 2025-02-18 - Asha Gupta: Initial ticket created after product review. PM requested prioritization due to upcoming console release. Scope scoped to onboarding/quickstart assets only; excludes deep-console dashboards.

2025-02-20 - Jordan Reyes: Began audit pass. Early findings: welcome banner CTA color fails AA in dark mode at 16px, most micro-icons lose definition at 12px. Will iterate on stroke weights and introduce 1px inset stroke for dark glyphs.

2025-02-25 - Accessibility Team (Eve Park): Provided automated contrast report and recommended stepping some greys to 2-3 tokens lighter/darker to meet 4.5:1. Suggested testing with simulated cataract filter—passed on sample screens.
2025-03-01 - Jordan Reyes: Uploaded updated icon set and token mapping to Figma. Started export to tokens.json and prepared initial screenshot templates. Creating design -> dev handoff notes now.
2025-03-03 - PM (Luca Moretti): Confirmed release window and asked to include copy variations for shortened onboarding flow in dark mode screenshots. Added as a follow-up task.
2025-03-04 - Jordan Reyes: Marked in-progress work items done for icon refresh; pending dev PR and QA pass. Leaving remaining tasks in next_steps.

2025-03-04 - Accessibility Team (Eve Park): Quick manual check on latest Figma frames: all CTAs now meet 4.5:1, large labels meet 3:1. Recommend final run with actual device screenshots in staging before close.
decisions: Use semantic icon set v3 (tokenized) instead of legacy glyphs to improve shape recognition in dark backgrounds
Adopt dedicated dark-mode color tokens instead of relying on inverted light tokens; explicit hex values will be used in tokens.json
Keep motion for progress micro-interactions but respect system 'prefers-reduced-motion' and provide motion-safe alternative frames in export

Open dev-facing PR with annotated screenshots and token mapping; request frontend review (Jordan)
Run device screenshot pass with staging build and capture for docs (QA)
PM to review copy variations and confirm final images for release notes (Luca)
Accessibility SME to perform final manual check and sign-off once staging screenshots are available (Eve)
